findings.summary: The product offers both hosted and self-hosted electronic-signature workflows, with public source code under AGPL.
Open source access, self-hosting, privacy control, and lower signing costs are the clearest positive themes.
The project has substantial developer interest, with roughly 14.4 thousand GitHub stars and 3 thousand forks at research time.
Users who complete setup describe the interface and daily signing workflow as simple and pleasant.
Self-hosted setup can involve certificate, permissions, Docker, and environment troubleshooting.
Strong launch and repository attention do not prove broad customer satisfaction because formal review-platform coverage remains very small.
Current security behavior, support quality, and the full 2.0 workflow require version-specific hands-on validation before making a scored claim.

config.research_note: Formal review-platform volume is thin. Product Hunt, GitHub, and self-hosting community evidence provide the strongest usable signals.
